source_text.GH#2697: REVIEWER code gate for PR 1: request-side restricted-field walker on row query and export.

task.description: WF-02 REVIEWER code gate for GH #2697 PR 1. Read-only; no mix run.

result.summary: PASS. IDIOM: pure walker (RequestGuard) separated from loader/composer (FieldPolicy); with-chains, pattern-matched clauses, closed-registry fail-closed, every public fn has @spec/@doc; no process/macro/behaviour machinery. SUPERVISION: n/a (no processes added). BEHAVIOUR PRESERVATION: run_query chain order Compiler.compile -> TypeAccess -> Allowlist -> Cursor.paginate -> redact preserved (guard inserted before compile only); redact/3 now reuses guard sets (no second load_restrictions), keys primary + each join.entity_type all present in sets because restriction_entity_types/2 includes primary, ref owners and join targets, so Map.fetch! cannot miss; type-denied keeps hidden 200 (guard_row_request skips field check, redact never sees :type_denied); redact fails closed by FunctionClauseError. Export: unredacted skips redaction as before; guard->compile->audit->paginate ordering matches design 6. All join_relations/guard error atoms map to existing render_query_error clauses; :invalid_schema_name hits the INV-8 catch-all 500; new clause maps both guard atoms to one 403 with the aggregate route's exact detail; export_audit_failed clause added before catch-all. SCOPE: aggregate route (run_query_aggregate/4, check_aggregate_field_restrictions/2) untouched (#2699 intact); lib diff = +56 compiler, +132/-43 router, +95 field_policy, +185 request_guard (~510 lib lines), within ~1250 bound; Compiler.join_relations/3 reuses resolve_all_raw_relations (no second copy of fk rules). DECISION RECORDS: 0051 D6 export scope filter absent, exemption ships without it per design Q3 (accepted, record in PR body). DEAD CODE: FieldPolicy.redact/3, redact_with_sets/3 and RequestGuard.check/2 have no production caller (unit-test-only per design; acceptable, but PR 2 or a follow-up must either use or delete them). DEV AMBIGUITIES: (1) audit after_state lists only exempted (restricted) field names, not all filter/sort fields: reasonable, matches 'restricted_fields_used' semantics and never logs values; (2) primary-entity sets always loaded even on unredacted export: reasonable, one cheap indexed read and the sets are needed anyway for the exempt comparison. NON-BLOCKING NITS: see findings.

findings.note: Untracked leak-repro test for GH #2682/req511 scope (instances event field_values), unrelated to #2697. Must not be staged in the #2697 PR 1 commit; belongs to the #2682 branch/issue.
alias Letflow.Entities.FieldPolicy placed after ManagedTypes; keep alias block alphabetical (FieldPolicy before ManagedTypes).

redact/3 third arg is overloaded ({:checked, guard_ok} | restriction_sets) purely to bridge run_query and export_redact; consider unwrapping in run_query (with pattern {:ok, {:checked, %{sets: sets}}}) so redact/3 takes only sets. Not blocking.
moduledoc/comment references test/letflow/entities/query_request_guard_test.exs which does not exist yet; TEST-DESIGNER must create it (T-26 tripwire) or the reference goes stale.
@type join_relations_error duplicates Compiler.join_relations_error alias; harmless, could be dropped.
try/rescue around Audit.insert_entry is intentional fail-closed and documented; acceptable since insert_entry returns tuples but may raise on DB failure.
